voice.summary: Sounds like a thoughtful component author: precise about focus, keys and escape routes, and relaxed about everything else. Copy states the pattern and the guarantee in one line.
dos: Name the pattern and its keyboard behaviour
Use verbs that match the button action
Keep body copy to a sentence
donts: Do not use scare language in destructive dialogs
Do not trap users without an escape

taglines: Focus in, focus back, no surprises
Every overlay has a way out
boilerplate: Hatchway is a kit of accessible dialog components, including confirm modals, form dialogs, side drawers and bottom sheets, with focus trapping, Escape handling and consistent behaviour.

microcopy.success: Changes saved. The dialog is closed.
microcopy.error: Couldn't save. Review the highlighted field.
microcopy.empty: Nothing selected. Open a dialog to begin.

logo.note: Layered panes picture dialogs stacked above a page.
